summary: April CPI dropped today, the single biggest market catalyst this week, landing as stocks trade at record highs with elevated momentum. Simultaneously, the U.S. rejected Iran's terms late Sunday, pushing crude oil up roughly 3% toward $100 per barrel, injecting fresh inflation risk into the print.
tweet: April CPI hits today as crude nears $100 after U.S.-Iran talks collapse — inflation vs. momentum is the defining tension across every asset class right now.
